case.summary: Customer C09582 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $236.28 (3660350) on card C09582-K1. Investigation revealed a definitive card-testing sequence on 2017-01-14, where four low-value online authorizations between $1.53 and $3.46 were executed within 27 minutes immediately prior to the larger purchase. This online activity on product C represents an abrupt shift from the holder's established historical baseline of over 700 in-person transactions on product W. The episode is confirmed as card_testing fraud with total exposure of $246.38, leading to card blocking and transaction declines.
